shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && find .agents -type f && echo ---- && cat AGENTS.md && echo ---- && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head

head -80 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && rg -n -i "table|grid|pagination" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60 && echo ---- && find src -type f | xargs ls -la && cat src/*.tsx 2>/dev/null | head -150; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -80; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -30

(curl -sS -m 20 -o /tmp/uikit7.txt -w "%{http_code}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; wc -c /tmp/uikit7.txt; head -c 300 /tmp/uikit7.txt) 2>&1; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | rg '"exports"' -A3 | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && ls components/Table/hoc components/Pagination && cat components/Table/Table.d.ts components/Table/hoc/*.d.ts && echo ---- && cat components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120; grep -n "Table\|Pagination" components/index.d.ts index.d.ts

cat components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts && echo ---- && cat components/Pagination/types.d.ts && echo ---- && cat components/Table/index.d.ts && echo ---- && grep -n "Checkbox\|Pagination\|Text" components/index.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc && cat withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -150; echo ----; cat withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && rg -n -A12 "static getRowId" Table/Table.js; rg -n "sort" Table/hoc/withTableSorting/SortIndicator/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls Table/hoc/withTableSorting/; cat Pagination/Pagination.js | head -60; cat Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -60
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui && wc -l rules/hallucination-traps.md references/layout.md && cat rules/hallucination-traps.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls components/layout; rg -n "export .*Flex" components/layout/index.d.ts components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; rg -n "view\?:" components/Button/Button.d.ts components/Button/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; rg -n "export .* Button\b|export \{.*Button" components/Button/index.d.ts | head -3; rg -n "'flat'" components/Button/*.d.ts | head -3; rg -n "variant" components/Text/types.d.ts | head -3

rg -n "ButtonView =" -A3 components/Button/*.d.ts | head -8; rg -n "export .*Flex|export \* from \"./layout" components/index.d.ts index.d.ts | head; rg -n "variant" components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -3; ls components/Text; rg -n "emptyMessage" components/Table/Table.js | head -2; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls node_modules/.bin | rg "^(tsc|vite)$"; git status --short
cat .gitignore; echo ----; ls node_modules | rg -i "^(jsdom|happy-dom|@testing-library)$"; git status --short
rm -rf dist && git status --short && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK
